name: Advisor Agreement
description: A short agreement under which a startup gives an outside advisor equity in return for a few hours of advice a month. The checks read for the amount of equity, a vesting schedule, an assignment of what the advisor creates, confidentiality, a statement that advising does not conflict with the advisor's other obligations, and — where the grant is an option — an exercise price at fair market value or set under the company's plan. Distinct from `consulting-agreement`, which reads a paid services engagement.
compliance_matrix_columns: Assignment of what the advisor creates
No conflict with the advisor's other obligations
Option priced at fair market value, or under the company's plan
